empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

list.emptyBody: A skill is a reusable Markdown instruction block that agents inject into their prompt. Create one or import a SKILL.md / .zip file.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is text only: a Markdown body injected into an agent's prompt as its own block.
create.defaultBody:
# Rule

Describe what the reviewer should look for.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameInvalid: Use kebab-case: lowercase letters, digits and single dashes (max 64).
fields.descriptionCaption: The skill's interface — write it as a directive: 'Use when…'

versions.title: Versions
versions.hint: Each edit of the name, description, type or body creates a version. Diff compares a version with the current one; Restore saves its body as a new version.
versions.select: Select a version to see its body.
versions.diffLabel: Diff v{version} with the current version
versions.diffTitle: Changes from v{from} to the current v{to}
versions.noDiff: The body is the same as the current version.

delete.title: Delete skill {name}?
delete.usedBy: {count, plural, =0 {Not used by any agent.} one {Used by # agent — its link will be removed.} other {Used by # agents — their links will be removed.}}

ack.title: Enable an imported skill
ack.body: “{name}” was imported from a file. Read its text in the Preview tab before you enable it.
ack.statement: I have read this text; it will be injected into the agent's prompt as instructions

import.title: Import skill from file
import.subtitle: A SKILL.md file or a .zip with SKILL.md at its root or in one top-level folder (≤ 512 KB).
import.rawSource: Raw SKILL.md (exactly as it will be parsed — never rendered)
import.trust: This text will be injected into the agent's prompt as instructions. The skill is saved disabled; enabling it the first time asks you to confirm you have read it.

errors.skill_name_taken: A skill with this name already exists.
errors.skill_ack_required: Confirm you have read an imported skill before enabling it.
errors.skill_not_in_workspace: A skill in the list does not belong to this workspace.
errors.import_unsupported_file: Only .md and .zip files can be imported.
errors.import_too_large: The file is too large (max 512 KB upload, 1 MB unpacked, 200 entries).
errors.import_bad_archive: The file could not be read (corrupt archive or not UTF-8 text).
errors.import_unsafe_path: The archive contains an unsafe path (.., absolute, drive letter or symlink).
errors.import_no_skill_md: No SKILL.md at the archive root or in one top-level folder.
errors.import_bad_frontmatter: The SKILL.md frontmatter is not valid YAML.
errors.import_description_missing: Write a description — the file has none.
errors.import_invalid_name: The name must be kebab-case (lowercase letters, digits, single dashes).
errors.import_invalid_field: The skill is out of bounds: the description must be at most 500 characters and the body 1 to 50,000 characters.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
